# Hosts the software itself may name in source.
#
# This is about the project's own dependencies -- upstream APIs, specifications,
# documentation -- never about where it happens to run. A deployment's own
# hostname is configuration and must be read from the environment, so that the
# same code serves every installation.
#
# One host or suffix per line. A leading dot matches subdomains.

# Cluster-internal and local
localhost
127.0.0.1
.svc
.svc.cluster.local
.local

# Reserved for examples and tests (RFC 2606 / 6761)
example.com
example.org
example.net
.example
.invalid
.test
